INITIAL_BLOG_POSTS.title: How to Choose Between Analog HD and IP Surveillance in Bangladesh
INITIAL_BLOG_POSTS.author: CamneX Technical Team
INITIAL_BLOG_POSTS.excerpt: An objective engineering breakdown comparing cost, cable distance, image clarity, and long-term expandability.
INITIAL_BLOG_POSTS.content: When planning a surveillance setup in Dhaka, property owners frequently balance budget constraints against technical longevity. Analog HD (Turbo HD / HD-TVI) remains cost-effective for 2 to 8 camera residential layouts, whereas IP PoE solutions provide unmatched scalability and analytics for multi-story corporate facilities...

INITIAL_FAQS.question: Are all Hikvision and ZKTeco products 100% genuine?
INITIAL_FAQS.answer: Yes. Every device supplied by CamneX Bangladesh carries an authentic factory serial number verifiable through official manufacturer partner verification channels, accompanied by warranty documentation.

INITIAL_FAQS.question: Can I view surveillance streams on my smartphone outside Bangladesh?
INITIAL_FAQS.answer: Yes. We configure encrypted cloud P2P (Hik-Connect / DMSS) on your smartphones and laptops, allowing live streaming and playback review globally without static IP requirements.

INITIAL_FAQS.question: Can you visit my location in Dhaka before installation?
INITIAL_FAQS.answer: Yes. A technician can inspect your premises in Dhaka to assess cable routes and prepare a bill of materials.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: Digital camera that connects to a computer network
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Sends and receives video data over an Ethernet network cable without separate coaxial lines.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: Camera that sends video over coaxial cable
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Standard surveillance camera connected directly to a DVR recorder using coaxial video cable.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: The box that records video from analogue cameras
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Digital Video Recorder that connects to coaxial cameras and stores footage on hard drives.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: The box that records video from network IP cameras
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Network Video Recorder that connects to IP cameras over network switches or built-in PoE ports.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: Power sent through the network cable
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Power over Ethernet technology that sends both electrical power and data over one network cable.
Uses invisible infrared light LEDs to illuminate the scene in black and white at night.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: A camera you can turn and zoom by remote
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Pan-Tilt-Zoom camera that can rotate horizontally, tilt vertically, and zoom optically via app or joystick.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: Infrared in the dark, plus a white light that gives a color picture when motion is detected
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Stays discreet with infrared night vision, then switches to a soft white light for color video when a person or vehicle is detected.
Uses large lens apertures and sensitive sensors to deliver vibrant color video even in very dark conditions.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: Camera that connects wirelessly to your router
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Standalone security camera that streams and records video directly through your home or office Wi-Fi network.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: Small memory card inside the camera for recordings
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Local onboard flash memory storage card inserted into the camera so it records without an NVR.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: Cylinder-shaped camera with visible pointing direction
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Elongated cylindrical camera body with sunshield, easy to aim and mount on walls or poles.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: Circular dome-shaped camera mounted flat to ceilings or walls
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Compact circular dome camera with transparent casing, ideal for clean indoor ceilings and discreet monitoring.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: Ball-and-socket camera with no glass dome reflection
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Eyeball design that prevents infrared light glare and dust buildup commonly seen on glass domes.

INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.shortMeaning: Millions of pixels measuring picture sharpness
INITIAL_GLOSSARY_TERMS.longMeaning: Megapixels indicate image detail: 2MP is 1080p Full HD, 4MP is 2K Quad HD, and 8MP is 4K Ultra HD.
